column1: Notice Calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
THE Mediation Boards Commission, by virtue of the powers vested in it by Section 4(1) of the Mediation (Special Categories
of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, invites nominations for the appointment of Chairman and Mediators in respect of resolving
all  disputes  relating  to  State  Lands  and  Private  Lands  subject  to  the  provisions  contained  in  the  Extraordinary  Gazette
Notification No. 2261/68 dated 06.01.2022 for the following Panel of Special Mediation Board who is to vacate post in terms
of sections 1 to 5 in the Schedule of the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act No. 21 of 2003.
